name: personal-firecrawl
description: Research the web with your self-hosted Firecrawl search and fetch tools, plus on-host CLI bulk work.

interface.shortDescription: Research the web with your Firecrawl.
interface.longDescription: Look up, verify and research questions through your authenticated self-hosted Firecrawl MCP search and fetch tools, with your agent doing the reasoning and optional subagent fan-out. On the Firecrawl host, map, crawl and download sites to local files through the CLI.
defaultPrompt: Look this up with my Firecrawl and cite the pages you read.
Research this multi-clue question with my Firecrawl and give your best answer with confidence.
Verify this claim against primary sources with my Firecrawl.
Map this site with the Firecrawl CLI and save the URL list.
